text: For grouped data with equal class sizes, first identify the modal class (the class with the highest frequency). Estimate the mode by Mode = l + [(f₁ − f₀)/(2f₁ − f₀ − f₂)] × h, where l is the modal class lower limit, h is class width, f₁ is modal-class frequency, f₀ is the preceding-class frequency, and f₂ is the succeeding-class frequency.

meta.extractiveQuote: “In a grouped frequency distribution, it is not possible to determine the mode by looking at the frequencies. Here, we can only locate a class with the maximum frequency, called the modal class.”
